component.name: Vagnarok File Manager
component.summary: Native high-performance file manager written in Rust
Gerenciador de arquivos nativo de alta performance em Rust
Gestor de archivos nativo de alto rendimiento en Rust
Gestionnaire de fichiers natif haute performance en Rust
Gestore di file nativo ad alte prestazioni in Rust

description.p: Vagnarok File Manager is a native GPU-accelerated desktop file manager built 100% in Rust with Iced and wgpu, featuring virtualized Grid, Detail Table, and Miller Columns views, live directory watching, fuzzy deep search, Git telemetry, ArchiveVfs navigation (.zip/.tar/.tar.gz), floating Properties windows, and multi-language Project Fluent localization.
Adds Windows Recycle Bin sidebar/listing/restore support, hides the Windows console window in release builds, and fixes duplicate window controls on Windows.
Adds multi-platform packaging (.deb, Flatpak, Windows Inno Setup + portable ZIP), language selector dropdown, Windows filesystem error mapping fixes, and updated project documentation.
First public alpha release: LocalFs, ArchiveVfs, virtualized views, SIMD thumbnails, floating Properties, 6 languages via Project Fluent, and GPLv3 licensing.
